title: Daily briefing: Old hearts ‘de-age’ in younger people
title_zh: 每日简报：老年心脏在年轻人中“逆龄”
abstract: Epigenetic 'clocks' suggest that transplanted organs adjust to the host's biological age. Plus, a new biography of Stephen Hawking and how sham societies are misleading star researchers.
abstract_zh: 表观遗传“时钟”表明移植器官会适应宿主的生物年龄。此外，关于斯蒂芬·霍金的新传记以及假社会如何误导顶尖研究者的报道也被提及。
snippet: Epigenetic 'clocks' suggest that transplanted organs adjust to the host's biological age. Plus, a new biography of Stephen Hawking and how sham societies are misleading star researchers.
